items.name: bento
items.title: Bento
items.description: Bento grid (2/4/6/12 columns, dashboard/feature/profile area presets) with tiles that are their own query containers. One column on narrow containers, DOM order equals visual order, never grid-auto-flow: dense.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Each tile holds at most one interactive target: pass href and label for the stretched-link pattern, and do not nest other links or buttons in that tile. Tiles enter with yorha-stagger; the hover lift moves only transform.
